name: Task
description: Background task record. Tracks long-running operations (deploys, migrations, batch jobs) with status, worker assignment, timestamps, and an associated resource. Supports retries and cancellation. ACL is read-only via generic CRUD: task lifecycle (create, status transitions, cancel) goes through TaskService — direct CRUD on a Task row could forge completion or corrupt the scheduler's view of the job.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Initiator — id of user who created this task. representsOwnership drives the ownership filter (52-D.2 / 52-D.3).

attributes.name: message
attributes.description: The most recent message to indicate task progress

attributes.name: resourceType
attributes.description: The type of entity that being processed by this task.

attributes.name: resourceId
attributes.description: The id of entity (activity, workflow) being processed by it.

attributes.name: conversationId
attributes.description: Agent conversation id this task belongs to (the conversation Task's own id). Set on child tasks (functions/sub-agents spawned during a conversation) and self-referenced on the conversation Task, so all tasks of a conversation group by conversationId. Null outside a conversation.

attributes.name: uuid
attributes.description: plan-69 — parquet-friendly natural key; distinct from the bigint id.

attributes.name: parentTaskId
attributes.description: plan-69 — parent task in the nested-call tree (-1 = root).

attributes.name: rootTaskId
attributes.description: plan-69 — root of the nested-call tree (self for a root task).

attributes.name: executorKind
attributes.description: plan-69 — kind of the task's root executor: function | agent.

attributes.name: executorName
attributes.description: plan-69 — name of the agent/function that owns the root turn. For agent conversations this equals the agent name (also in 'name').

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: plan-69 — human title for a conversation (type="agent"). Null for plain tasks.

attributes.name: lastTurnAt
attributes.description: plan-69 — epoch millis of the last message/turn in a conversation.

attributes.name: messageCount
attributes.description: plan-69 — count of user-visible messages in a conversation.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: plan-69 — conversation lifecycle (e.g. active/archived). Kept SEPARATE from task 'status' (which carries execution state: running/done/failed). Null for plain tasks.
